name: IARD - 02 Sub-workflow: Intake & Parse

nodes.name: Execute: Parse Completed Audit Working File (xlsx)
nodes.notes: Row-level extraction into working_file_row per the export schema (risk, control, test steps, work done, test status/result, residual risk level, evidence refs).

nodes.name: Execute: Parse Kick-off Deck (pptx)
nodes.notes: Extracts objectives, scope, review period, stakeholder/acknowledgment text, and the 3 audit-team name+title pairs (D-3 alignment).

nodes.name: Execute: Parse Optional Inputs (notification / process understanding incl. legacy .ppt / analysis sheet)
nodes.notes: Only runs for inputs actually present. Legacy .ppt must be handled (FR-05). Any embedded image content is NOT auto-placed in the pilot — flagged as a known limitation pending scope decision.

main.node: Execute: Parse Completed Audit Working File (xlsx)
Execute: Parse Optional Inputs (notification / process understanding incl. legacy .ppt / analysis sheet)

description: Registers each uploaded engagement document, flags missing optional inputs, and fans out to the per-format parsers. Sanitised: credentials removed, client identifiers anonymised.
